findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: shorti_what_to_shoot, shorti_format, shorti_video, shorti_edit_recipe, shorti_remake_recipe, shorti_scene_kit, shorti_check_link · Private data: shorti_scene_kit, shorti_check_link, shorti_campaigns_for_me · Public sink: shorti_my_field, shorti_find, shorti_video, shorti_edit_recipe, shorti_remake_recipe, shorti_scene_kit, shorti_check_link · Destructive: shorti_what_to_shoot, shorti_format, shorti_flow, shorti_edit_recipe, shorti_remake_recipe, shorti_check_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: shorti_what_to_shoot, shorti_format, shorti_video, shorti_edit_recipe, shorti_remake_recipe, shorti_scene_kit, shorti_check_link · Private data: shorti_scene_kit, shorti_check_link, shorti_campaigns_for_me · Public sink: shorti_my_field, shorti_find, shorti_video, shorti_edit_recipe, shorti_remake_recipe, shorti_scene_kit, shorti_check_link · Destructive: shorti_what_to_shoot, shorti_format, shorti_flow, shorti_edit_recipe, shorti_remake_recipe, shorti_check_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
